jobs.description:
Company Description
Astera Labs (NASDAQ: ALAB) delivers rack-scale AI infrastructure through purpose-built connectivity solutions that help organizations fully leverage modern AI. By working closely with hyperscalers and ecosystem partners, the company designs Intelligent Connectivity Platform solutions that integrate CXL®, Ethernet, NVLink™ Fusion, PCIe®, and UALink™ technologies with its COSMOS software suite. This platform unifies diverse components into cohesive, scalable systems that support both scale-up and scale-out connectivity. Astera Labs also provides custom connectivity solutions alongside its standards-based portfolio, enabling customers to deploy architectures tailored to their specific infrastructure requirements. More information about the company and its offerings can be found at www.asteralabs.com.
Role Description
This is an on-site internship role for a Product Application Engineer based in San Jose, CA. The intern will support customer-facing technical engagements by helping to evaluate product requirements, assist in system-level integration, and provide hands-on debugging and troubleshooting of connectivity solutions. Day-to-day responsibilities include working with senior engineers to reproduce and analyze customer issues, preparing technical documentation and application notes, and contributing to reference designs, demos, and lab setups. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams such as sales, R&D, and product management to communicate customer feedback, validate new features, and help ensure successful deployment of Astera Labs products in AI infrastructure environments.
Qualifications

Strong foundation in Electrical Engineering and related disciplines, with coursework or project experience in high-speed interfaces, systems design, or semiconductor technologies.
Ability to provide Technical Support for hardware and software products, including responding to customer inquiries and assisting with implementations.
Hands-on Troubleshooting skills for lab setups and customer systems, including use of test equipment, debugging tools, and systematic problem-solving methods.
Interest in collaborating with Sales teams to translate technical capabilities into customer value and support technical aspects of customer evaluations.
Exposure to Research and Development (R&D) activities such as prototyping, validating new features, and contributing to technical experiments or performance analysis.
Pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
Solid written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document findings clearly and present technical information to diverse audiences.
Comfort working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and eagerness to learn about AI infrastructure and advanced connectivity technologies.

RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Mission Systems is a trusted provider of mission-enabling solutions for global security. We have a wide portfolio of secure, affordable, integrated, and multi-domain systems and technologies. Our differentiated battle management and cyber solutions deliver timely, mission-enabling information and provide superior situational awareness and understanding to protect the U.S. and its global allies.

Entry Level opportunities at Northrop Grumman are unique. Are you interested in boosting your knowledge through experience and exposure, while supporting a mission that seeks to protect our nation and its allies? If so, then Northrop Grumman is the place you!

Our professionals live and breathe different perspectives; we are curious about the world, accepting each other, and aware that the more ideas, backgrounds, opinions and experiences we bring to our work, the stronger that work will be. Just as you would invest your time and hard work into our company, we focus on investing back into you through enriching professional experiences and high-quality learning and development opportunities. We want you to bring your whole self to work, and for you to have meaningful connections with your coworkers, customers and communities, while providing the best products, systems and technologies to protect our world.

Northrop Grumman Mission Systems is seeking a Software Engineer in McClellan, CA to help deliver next-generation national defense capabilities in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment.

Roles And Responsibilities

The new team member will design, develop, document, test and debug software applications and systems that contain logical and mathematical solutions.
Conduct multidisciplinary research and collaborates with equipment designers and/or hardware engineers in the planning, design, development, and utilization of software solutions.
Determine computer user needs; analyzes system capabilities to resolve problems on program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques and controls; prepares operating instructions; designs and develops compilers and assemblers, utility programs, and operating systems.
Implement solutions in multiple components of the system, including storage, OS, network, application, database, and many more.
Provide system analysis as an actual user, including onsite visits, and contribute to the next iteration of the system through feedback and development.
Ensure software standards are met.

Responsibilities

Build and enhance software, leveraging feedback as an end user and field rep
Use container engines and container tools to develop OCI-compliant container images for existing software applications (e.g. Docker images)
Design, develop, document, test and debug applications software and systems that contain logical and mathematical solutions
Follow software development standards for configuration management, software reuse, and Dev*Ops processes

Basic Qualifications For a Software Engineer

A candidate must meet ALL of the below criteria. The candidate must:

Be completing or has completed their degree (Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD) from an accredited institution in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similar STEM degree from an accredited institution

Object-oriented development in Java, or C/C++
Scripting and web: Python, JavaScript, HTML, CSS
Data and storage: SQL/relational databases;
Linux experience: filesystems/mounts, cron, bash scripting, services, permissions, users/groups
DevOps: GitLab (repos, runners, pipelines), integration with artifact/binary storage, use of monitoring tools (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Grafana)
Networking: practical troubleshooting with tools like ss, nc, netstat, tcpdump, ip addr; understanding of core protocols and debugging strategies
Understanding of containers, containerized development, and deployment
End-to-end software development lifecycle experience
Be able to obtain a U.S. Government security clearance (U.S. citizenship is a pre-requisite)

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on design, deployment, and dynamic management of containerized systems
Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and pub/sub (topics) architectures
Proficiency using REACT framework
Experience with Kubernetes (K8s, k3s) and cloud-native OS environments
Experience with modern software factories and DevOps/DevSecOps practices
Familiarity with Atlassian and CI/CD tools: Bitbucket, JIRA, Jenkins, Confluence
Advanced scripting in Python, Bash, and related languages
Practical experience working in Agile and DevOps teams
Strong background in object-oriented software design and implementation
Experience with both front-end and back-end User Interface development.

Salary Range

Salary Range Level 1: $ 76,200 -$114,400

campusjobs

Primary Level Salary Range: $76,200.00 - $114,400.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.
